rows.behavior: A rewrite with a non-blank line under What changed that is neither a '- ' bullet nor indented under one, such as an intro paragraph before the first bullet or an unindented line after a bullet, fails the stray-line check, so the draft stands with a ::warning:: naming stray-line.
rows.fails_when: such a rewrite is kept, or the warning does not name stray-line

rows.behavior: An indented continuation line under a bullet is still joined and kept, and a draft whose What changed holds 'None.' passes when the rewrite keeps that line; every earlier check still behaves as before.
rows.fails_when: a continuation line or the draft's own 'None.' fails a rewrite, or any existing cleaning-script test fails
